nodes.text: Three runners are stable enough to move, two civilians are in shock, and the station's auto-doc is cycling on stolen power. Give us a corridor and we'll reach your shuttle under our own legs.

options.text: You're coming with us. Be ready to move.
What happens if we leave you here?
The vault is already open. Can you still move now?

nodes.text: Patrol evidence teams don't take witnesses. They'll call it contamination control and vent this room into the black. If you're offering extraction, say it plain so I can keep these people breathing until the doors open.

options.text: Hold for a few more minutes.

nodes.text: If the vault is open, then the station is already screaming across every patrol net in range. We can still move, but not if you wait for a cleaner answer than that.

options.text: Then get your people ready. We extract now.
